R.rule: first k valid trials per cell per arm, k largest that fits the Claude budget
R.deterministic: no-statement (no paragraph attributed to the decision point), fewer-than-2-options (R2), no-alternatives (R5) are not-met without a model call

S2.rule: per arm up to 40 candidates, round-robin over cells then records

limitations: Paragraph-to-decision-point attribution is by evaluator keywords; a decision written in other words counts as no-statement (not-met). Rates are therefore lower bounds and arms that write in a different register may be under-read.
R2 option spans are extracted by list / marker heuristics; prose alternatives without markers are missed (fewer-than-2-options).
S2 candidates are path citations whose sentence may describe the agent's own action rather than the file; such claims are judged not-met by construction.
Claude (haiku) judging a Claude subject: self-preference risk remains (planning 23 §10). Validation set was 3 met / 3 not-met per item.
Observations in a bundle are a window (issue body + up to 4 tool results sharing tokens with the paragraphs), not the whole trajectory; a decisive observation outside the window makes R4 not-met.

rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"

  : > "$dir/$name"
